name: COMP_017
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (60%)** · Ambiguous: Invasive vs InSitu · Careful review
Tier 1 surgical frozen section with unseparated InSitu [F1] and suggested tumor at three margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 60%, InSitu 20%, Normal 17%, Benign 3% | Favors Invasive; InSitu remains possible |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (90% coverage; ECE 5%, n=132) | Cannot separate Invasive from InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | Reliability 96%, OOD 76%, 12/12 tiles kept [F6] | Typical image quality; not flagged |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class (true) | Independent backbones agree on top |
| Similar cases | 3/5 Invasive, 2/5 InSitu (60%; 84%–88% similarity) [F5] | Split between Invasive and InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 1, 3, 4) · context · Above-typical inflammatory score (-1.13 [F2]; 8/20 AI spot check) · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 2, 3, 10) · ↑ invasive · Unreliable pro-invasive score (+0.71 [F3]; 0/20 AI spot check) · Unreliable
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Unreliable counter-invasive score (-0.58 [F4]; 0/20 AI spot check) · Unreliable
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 2, 3, 11) · ↑ invasive · Validated pro-invasive score (+0.31; 18/20 AI spot check) · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 6) · ↑ invasive · Minor validated pro-invasive score (+0.12; 19/20 AI spot check) · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions beats random (drop +0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); leans on unreliable mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20), and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- High-risk regions (2, 3, 6, 7, 10, 11) are pure InSitu (matches contrast case `BACH_0165` at 84% similarity).
- Simulated composite frozen-section artifacts mimic stromal invasion or positive margins where stains are blocked and mitoses are unreliable.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 6, 10, 11**: Verify true stromal invasion versus InSitu in highest-risk regions (risk 98%–100%, pleomorphism, invasion).
2. **Regions 2, 3, 7, 10, 11**: Confirm tumor at superior (430 um), lateral (538 um), and inferior (430 um) margins.
3. **Regions 0, 1, 4, 8, 9**: Confirm benign lobules, fibrous stroma, and TILs in zero-risk left-half regions.
